run_bench_quantizer_pq: run the faiss product quantizer benchmark on SIFT1M with specified M and nbits parameters
run_bench_quantizer_rq: run the faiss residual quantizer benchmark with varying max beam size variants
run_bench_quantizer_lsq: run the faiss local search quantizer benchmark with varying ILS iteration counts

eval_quantizer_function: train and evaluate a faiss quantizer across multiple parameter variants on benchmark datasets
